title: Irreducible Governance Structure for Autonomous Agent Systems: Fair Allocation, Strategy-Proofness, and Multi-Scale Composition
description_en: arXiv:2611.31284v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous agent governance is commonly framed as a problem of enforcing correct execution. However, in multi-agent systems, an equally fundamental question precedes execution: which agents are allowed to act. In this paper, we show that allocation is not an auxiliary concern but a structural component of governance. When multiple agents compete for execution under constrained resources, any allocation mechanism introduces unavoidable trade-offs between fairness, efficiency, and resistance to strategic manipulation. We formalize this through a set of impossibility results, including Sybil amplification and the incompatibility of desirable allocation properties. title: MyClaw 3.0
description_en: Build an always-on AI team with shared memory. MyClaw lets you build your own AI team with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi, and more. Give each teammate its own role, tools, skills, and choice of 50+ models, with shared memory across your team. Your agents run on always-on cloud computers, use your apps, access data, and handle recurring tasks even when you're offline. Assign work from the web, Slack, Telegram, or WhatsApp. No server setup or lock-in to a single AI provider.

title: Hub
description_en: Run 100 Claude Code or Codex sessions like 5. Open-source dispatcher for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Write a goal in your browser or Telegram, a coordinator hands it to agents, and only the decisions come back. Self-hosted, Apache-2.0, on your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription. One-line install. Experimental: agents run without permission prompts.

title: Airbot
description_en: The AI chief of staff that texts you first. Most AI assistants wait for you to ask. Airbot texts you first. It checks the conversations, meetings, and customer updates spread across email, Slack, your calendar, and CRM, then brings you only the priorities that matter. Behind every message is work already prepared: a drafted response, a meeting brief, a booking, or a CRM change. Approve what should happen directly in WhatsApp or iMessage. Airbot helps founders and lean teams stay on top of work without living in their notifications.

title: Canva MCP
description_en: Turn any AI agent into a creative powerhouse. Canva MCP opens Canva's creative tools to AI agents and developers. Generate editable designs, images and videos, remove backgrounds, resize assets and automate on-brand creative workflows with MCP, REST APIs and CLI.

title: QA.tech MCP
description_en: Verify every change from your IDE with QA agents. QA.tech MCP gives Claude Code, Cursor or Codex an external QA agent to check their work. It runs E2E tests on what each change does to your product and finds the bugs and edge cases your coding agent missed, so they get fixed before the PR goes to review. Stay in your IDE: QA.tech explores your app, writes the tests and runs them. Your coding agent reads the results and fixes what broke. Works with any MCP client. New to QA.tech? One prompt maps your app and kicks off your first test.

title: Snag by Parallel
description_en: Find the best deals on products from your agents. Find the best deals on the products you've been asking ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents about. Snag turns those conversations into a wishlist you import in one click, matches each item to the exact product, and checks prices across stores. Lists are sorted by best deal, every price is rated against its list price, and any list can be shared with a link. 100% free, in time for Black Friday. Powered by the Parallel Shopping API and Parallel Images API.

title: ExtraOrbital
description_en: ✦ Open bar databases, storage buckets & AI keys for agents. Your app needs databases, storage, caching, AI keys, and more. That's dozens of accounts, API keys, invoices, and backups to manage. Agents can't stand it. They don't even have access. You feel like their credentials go-fetch puppet. ExtraOrbital reads yourenv.example file and creates all these ressources for you. It's a CLI, so your agents can use it. They don't even need an account. You gain back control, increase security and manage everything in a central dashboard. Bye bye,env hell !

title: Fompi
description_en: Personal security & privacy companion that calls out risks. Fompi sits quietly in your browser and on your Mac, and speaks up when it matters: a scam page, a phishing email, a disguised download, an AI notetaker in your call, an app on your mic, a card number headed for an AI chat. It tells you why. Free to start :)

title: Bifura
description_en: See your website the way AI agents do. AI assistants now read websites for your buyers. Bifura fetches your page the way AI crawlers do, shows what they get and get wrong, and lets you test fixes in a sandbox before you ship. Free Agent readiness score in under a minute, no signup.

title: Koed
description_en: Supercharged Agents!. Koed gives each coding project its own Kin: a customisable assistant that remembers how you like to work, the decisions you’ve made and what you’ve already tried. Your Kin reasons over that context to give Claude Code, Codex and Pi guidance shaped by your project, helping your agents work faster and use fewer tokens. Koed runs on-device and is free and open source. It’s available now for solo developers, with more coding agent integrations, optional cloud processing and team sharing coming soon.

title: Pax by Pydantic
description_en: A coding agent where even coding is a plugin. Pax is the official Pydantic AI coding agent for your terminal. Every part is a plugin, it runs any model, and --agent runs your own Pydantic AI agent in it.

title: Hai
description_en: Your AI assistant that actually makes the phone call. Some bookings still only happen by phone, and plenty of us dread making that call. For people who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have speech or anxiety barriers, that call can be impossible. Hai makes it for you. Tell your assistant what you need, approve the plan, and Hai places the call in any language to any business that takes bookings by phone, then reports back in text. Free to start. Built by an indie developer in Japan.

title: Omi X 2.0
description_en: Omi can build anything. Your $1B idea, live in production. Omi can build anything. Omi X 2.0 is the desktop app for Mac and Windows that builds a production AI SaaS on your own Google Cloud and Firebase. New in 2.0: Point and edit lets you click any part of your running app and tell Omi what to change. Open an existing project brings in your own Next.js app; Omi tests, builds and deploys it. New projects start from a tested starter. Plan free, no card; building from $29 a month.

title: Kagi Mail
description_en: Private email that puts people who need you first. Kagi Mail is a private email service designed to help you focus on what matters. Its intelligent inbox highlights people waiting for your reply, identifies emails that need action, and keeps newsletters and unwanted messages out of the way. Ask questions about your inbox, organize emails using natural-language rules, and use unlimited aliases and custom domains. No ads, no tracking, no profiling. Includes 50 GB storage and a built-in calendar, with open standards and no vendor lock-in.

title: RelayRunner
description_en: Swap between CI runners on-demand with zero code changes.. RelayRunner is a router for your existing CI runners, so you can use multiple providers or self-hosted options at the same time. Send each GitHub Actions job to the first free runner in your order: your own Mac, self-hosted runners, GitHub's default runners, or providers like Blacksmith and Boat. Change the order any time without touching your workflows. Open source, with a Mac app and a CLI that turn any machine into a runner on-demand.

title: 3way.Social MCP
description_en: Ask your AI to find link partners. You approve the deals.. 3way.Social is a fair, credit-based marketplace for link insertions and guest posts, with no cold outreach. Each site chooses what it buys and sells, links are priced on industry-standard metrics (DR, traffic, spam score), and if a link disappears you get your credits back. AI discovery finds specific pages on your topic, not just domains. The MCP brings it into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT: ask for partner pages for your new post, then approve the deal.

title: Doodle
description_en: The stick figure on your taskbar that answers questions. Doodle is a little AI companion that lives on your Windows taskbar. Ask it anything with Ctrl+Shift+Space, or dictate into any app. When it can't do something, Doodle Evolution builds a bespoke plugin, shows you what it can reach, and waits for your OK.

title: MAGI-2
description_en: Sand AI's 480B model for cinematic video generation. MAGI-2 is Sand AI's flagship video generation model, creating up to 30 seconds of 1080p video with synchronized native audio. Combine up to 20 image, video, and audio references to guide characters, scenes, styles, and sound. Direct shot changes and timeline events, or edit specific parts of existing videos. Built for creators who want more control over cinematic AI video production. Available through the Sand AI platform and API.

title: Falcon by Vybe
description_en: Falcon analyzes your competitors for free, then gets to work. Get a free competitor analysis. Falcon, a Vybe agent, digs into your rivals and delivers a deep report: market landscape, feature parity, momentum, gaps left open, and competitors' go-to-market motions. The whole picture, not just a list of competitors. Want more than the report? Falcon runs on Vybe, so you can let an agent take the wheel, keep you updated on where the market is headed and turn the findings into work.

title: VibeCode.surf
description_en: AI code editor where agents build, run and test your app. VibeCode.surf is an AI code editor for your desktop. Several agents plan, write, run and test your code on your own computer, with any model. Say what you want, and a lead agent splits the job across helpers that write the code, run it and test it in a real browser. It runs on your computer with any model, from Claude and GPT to a local one, and shows what every reply costs.

title: MemoryWorks
description_en: Company memory for people and AI agents. MemoryWorks is the memory layer for engineering organizations. It captures decisions, context and know-how from your team's sources and makes it available to people and AI agents, always tied back to where it came from. Works with ChatGPT and Claude Code via an MCP server. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

title: Tray
description_en: macOS file manager in a screen corner. A file manager for macOS that lives in a screen corner. Drop files on the shelf, preview them, group them into a folder, drag them anywhere, or send them to the Bin — without opening Finder.

title: Monton
description_en: AI agents that do your agency's busywork. Monton is agency management software with AI agents built in. Agents watch budgets, chase overdue invoices, write client reports and remind people about missing hours, on your real hours, staffing, billing and CRM data. Pick one of 18 templates or describe it in a chat. Every email waits for your approval. AI is included in every paid plan: no credits, no per-seat pricing. Free up to 5 people.

title: Continual-ARC
description_en: OpenClaw doesn't learn from experience. Does your agent?. Left to themselves, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and Prime Agent failed to memorize puzzles they'd already seen, and didn't get better at solving new ones. In contrast, a small 9B model trained on the same stream got better at both. Run yours on the open benchmark.

title: Tendeck
description_en: Run all your Claude Code and Codex agents on one Mac board. Every coding agent becomes a card on one board. The card turns gold when an agent needs you, so nothing waits 40 minutes for a "yes". Claude Code, Codex or any agent CLI, with worktrees, account switching and files on the card. $59 once.

title: DeskFleet
description_en: Run coding agents together across your team’s machines. DeskFleet gives your team a shared session with the coding agents you already use. Run Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor where your code lives. A teammate can join from their laptop, review the diff, approve the next command, or take control of the remote desktop. Your tools and agent credentials stay on the machine doing the work.

title: file.spot
description_en: File transfer for creative professionals. Share large files with clients on a delivery page in your own branding. Previews of every file, five layouts, and no account needed to download. Stored in the EU, no ads, and your work is never used for AI training.

title: Remora
description_en: The long-term memory layer for AI agents. Remora is continuous memory infrastructure for AI agents. Ingest conversations, deduplicate facts, and recall relevant context in under 15ms. Powered by PostgreSQL + pgvector with native Python & TypeScript SDKs. Stop re-inventing memory tables.

title: Watch Reader
description_en: Books and articles, read aloud on your Apple Watch. Add books, articles and web pages on your iPhone, then leave it at home. The AI voice runs on your Apple Watch itself, so it reads to you with no signal. Morning news, 25 voices, free classics. Free to download, with 30min free listening everyday forever.

title: SteerLatch
description_en: Connect MCP-compatible AIs to your computer. SteerLatch connects MCP-compatible AIs to your authorized Mac/Windows PC: files, desktop, terminal, STOP and revocable access. NEW: control your paired PC from a phone/browser after local setup, while AI works. SteerLatch Context Hub shares project memory and messages across agents. Official apps are live on Apple App Store (iPhone companion) and Microsoft Store (Windows). Free 3-month trial: 3 PCs, 5,000 MCP calls/month, no card.

title: Transept AI
description_en: Translate your book in your own voice and prove authorship . Since our first launch, Transept became a tool for writers translating their own books. New: you read the translation as a book, next to your original. Author mode reads your manuscript first and drafts the glossary, style guide and characters for you to approve. The Originality report records, word by word, what the AI wrote and what you changed. PDFs come back as the same pages. The Free plan translates your first page in full; paid plans from €9/$10 a month.

title: Flurra
description_en: Ask Claude or ChatGPT to edit your videos. Flurra is a video editor that Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants can use for you. Connect it once (sign in, no API key), then describe the edit: cut the dead air, add bold hook text, put your logo top-right, cut yourself onto a new background, or match the style of a video you love. Claude edits your Flurra project, you preview every change and keep only what you like, then it renders the 1080p cut. Flurra also writes scripts in your voice and plans your posts. iPhone and web.

title: Nookdeck
description_en: Turn your old phone into a Stream Deck for your computer. Nookdeck turns an old phone or tablet into a touch control panel for your Mac or Windows PC. A small app on the computer serves the panel to the phone's browser over Wi-Fi: no app to install on the phone, no account, no cloud. Old iPhones on iOS 12 work too. Buttons for shortcuts, apps, media and macros; live tiles for system stats, Now Playing and weather; Home Assistant controls; Claude and Codex usage; plugins and theme packs. Free and open source (MIT).

title: Meboki
description_en: Offline grammar checker for any Mac app. Open source. Most grammar checkers send everything you type to someone else's server. Meboki checks your English with an open-source AI model running on your own Mac. Wavy underlines appear as you type in Mail, Slack, Notion, Gmail and most other apps; press Return to fix them all. Like Grammarly's grammar and spelling fixes, but offline: no account, no subscription, no telemetry. GPL-3.0 source. $39 once, 50% off each for 3+ licences; free hotkey mode after the 7-day trial. Apple Silicon, macOS 14+.

title: PartGenie 2.0
description_en: The AI workspace for hardware engineering. PartGenie is the AI workspace for hardware engineering, connecting design, component intelligence, sourcing, and manufacturing in one place. Explore 60M+ electronic components, get datasheet-grounded answers, find verified alternatives & ECAD models, analyze BOMs, and move from engineering decisions to real-world sourcing and PCB/PCBA manufacturing. From design to build. Anywhere.

title: Statefold
description_en: Coding agents that keep working while you're away. Statefold runs your coding agent (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi or Gemini CLI) on its own cloud computer, so it keeps working after you close your laptop. Give it a task and it writes the code, tests it and opens a pull request. If a check fails or a reviewer leaves a comment, the agent sees it and fixes it in the same conversation. Review the changes and merge from your computer or your phone. It works with the subscription or API key you already pay for.

title: iwantmy.app
description_en: Describe a mobile app in chat and open it on your phone. Tell iwantmy.app what your app is for and who uses it. About a minute later it runs on a phone, with accounts, staff roles, bookings with places left, photos, maps and group chat built in. Ask for changes in chat; each one goes live when it is done, and a failed change leaves the app as it was. Open your app from its link or QR code in the phone's browser, or in our test app for iPhone and Android. Free plan: 1 app and 30 AI changes a month, no card.

title: Notely
description_en: Notion-grade power & BYOK AI, stored locally in SQLite. Ditch $120/yr note subscriptions. Notely is a 100% offline-first Windows 11 workspace backed by SQLite WAL + FTS5 search—no accounts, no telemetry, free forever. Open up to 24 Chrome-style tabs, write rich notes with resizable tables, sticky notes, built-in calculator & live inline stopwatch timers, compare word-level version history, lock sensitive notes with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM, export losslessnotely/PDF via Print Studio, and opt in to BYOK Gemini or GroqCloud AI.

title: Ground
description_en: Generate high quality synthetic data for testing or training. Ground turns a one-sentence description into consistent synthetic tables where every key, total and rate holds, or extends a dataset you already have. One sentence produced 72,365 rows with 0 orphan keys; asked for ~5% overdue, it delivered. Use it in the browser, via API, or from Claude, Claude Code and ChatGPT through its MCP server. If you need human written level data at scale Ground has you covered.

title: Upsolve Harness 2.0
description_en: A data agent that's 2x faster and learns every user. We rebuilt our agent harness from scratch for people who don't know the data. Twice as fast, self-correcting SQL, custom skills for your analyses, suggestions that improve it over time, and memory that personalises every user.

title: Hello Transcribe 5
description_en: Private transcription with speaker labels, all on device. Hello Transcribe turns speech into text on your iPhone, iPad and Mac, entirely on device: no account, no uploads. Free: Apple SpeechAnalyzer and every whisper.cpp model. PRO: Speaker labels with NVIDIA Nemotron, Parakeet v3 and Whisper on Core AI, iCloud Sync & Audio save.

title: Superframes
description_en: Brief an AI Director to edit the whole video. Superframes is an AI video editor with a Director inside. Give it a brief and it plans the edit, cuts it on a real timeline and lists each change, so you can undo one or all of them. It turns one long video into a board of captioned Shorts, and it generates the clip, voice or music you are missing. Editing runs on your device and your video files are never uploaded. Browser, Mac and Windows. Free to start, no account.

title: OpenChat
description_en: Open-source live chat in your own Cloudflare account. Customer chat for your website that runs in your own Cloudflare account, so conversations stay with you. A 2 KB widget in 11 languages, a team inbox on web, iPhone and Android with end-to-end encrypted notifications, a help centre, and an optional AI assistant that answers first and hands over to a person. Open source and self-hosted, with one-click deploy.

title: MeetFolks
description_en: AI Notetaker for In-Person Meetings. MeetFolks turns in-person meetings into named transcripts, summaries, and action items. Everyone joins from their own phone or laptop, so each person is captured close up by their own mic. Each device recognises its owner's voice, so you know who said what without labelling speakers yourself or buying a dedicated recorder.

title: MusicProductionAI
description_en: Make music from a prompt or a hum, right in your browser. Music production software that runs in a browser tab. Describe a track or upload a hummed melody and get an instrumental of 15, 30 or 60 seconds. Record, arrange and mix it in the built-in DAW, then export a WAV. Split any song into stems, find its chords and key, or program a beat on the free drum machine. Your first 3 tracks are free with no sign-up. After that it is pay as you go: one-time credit packs from $9, credits never expire, no subscription.

title: PeerBand
description_en: Reach every coding agent you run, from anywhere. Connect the coding agents you run in Herdr across your laptop, desktop, and VMs. Check what they’re working on from ChatGPT or another MCP client. Get a Telegram message when an agent needs you, then reply to that exact agent from your phone. Install PeerBand on each machine and reach your agents without SSH.

title: Chunkify
description_en: Video Streaming API for Developers & AI Agents. Chunkify is a video streaming platform for developers and AI agents. Your videos stay in your own S3 or R2 bucket and stream through your CDN, so you always own your data. One API covers the full pipeline: uploads, per-title adaptive encoding, HLS streaming, thumbnails, captions and playback analytics.

title: Antipode
description_en: Share your unused Claude Code limits without breaking ToS. Your Claude Code weekly limit resets whether you used it or not. With Antipode, your agent spends what's left on a public GitHub project whose owner asked for help and opens a pull request. When you run out, others' agents work on yours. Free, open source.

title: CodeRabbit Verify
description_en: AI agent that tests your running app on every pull request. CodeRabbit Verify is an agentic testing feature that runs your actual app in a sandbox and catches functional bugs before customers do. It builds test scenarios from a pull request, runs plain-English regression journeys on demand or on a schedule, and posts results with recordings, screenshots and logs. Findings can go to CodeRabbit Agent or another coding agent for a fix, or into Jira or Linear. Public beta: test runs are free.

title: Qube
description_en: An AI agent for anyone. Qube is a personal AI assistant that works on your behalf, not just answers. It plans, uses tools, checks its own output, and comes back with the job done — real files, cited research, forms filled, apps updated. It's proactive: set a goal or a schedule and it runs the task to the end, asking only when a decision or risky action needs you. Your files stay on your machine. Free and open-source. Bring your own model — cloud or local — the assistant and its autonomy are the product.

title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
description_en: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 85 skills, 16 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.

title: obra/superpowers
description_en: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.

title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
description_en: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub:https://clianything.cc/

title: jingyaogong/minimind
description_en: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.

title: firecrawl/firecrawl
description_en: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.

title: openvinotoolkit/openvino
description_en: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference

title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
description_en: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 52 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.

title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
description_en: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
description_en: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
description_en: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 125 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 117 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.

title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
description_en: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.

title: toeverything/AFFiNE
